coverage_definition:
PRESPECIFIED 0.11.0 calibration. Commit this script BEFORE first execution.

Seed 2026092911; 1000 independent simulations/row. Fixed additive Gaussian
response SD=1, amplitude=100, baseline=10. 31 concentrations (zero plus 30
log-spaced points 1e-12..1e-7 M); KD=1e-9 M. Pt/KD=0.01,0.1,1,10,100,
known or fitted Pt. SET constants 0.1/10 nM. Cell slope 1e8 response/M,
matched controls; competition Pt=1 nM, tracer=.1 nM, tracer KD=2 nM.

Coverage >= .95 - 2*sqrt(.95*.05/n_evaluable). Observed Monte Carlo SE also
reported. Evaluable = optimizer succeeded and a profile interval was computed;
open endpoints cover only within the declared search domain, not infinity.
Point-withheld fits remain in interval coverage and are counted separately.
Titration withholding rows at Pt/KD=10,100 fitted use the same >=.95-2SE bound;
these evaluate the implemented reporting rule under repeated sampling, not
correctness of an apparently precise estimate. No failed simulation is hidden.
Hyperbola depletion bias is descriptive, never a gate. No post-run tuning.
